# Pilot Run {#sec-appendix-pilot}

The pilot run was done before the tuning runs to check that every model fits in the 8 GB of GPU memory of the laptop and to set the limit on the growth of shared GPU memory used to check run validity (Section 3.9). Each model was trained for \[number\] steps with batch size 8, first with all layers trained and then with the embedding layer of the encoder frozen. During each run, nvidia-smi recorded the GPU every second (Section 3.4), and the memory counters of Windows recorded the shared GPU memory (Section 3.9).
